notes: The session's shared web-search allowance ran out after six searches, so the rest was read by opening pages directly with the kit's honest User-Agent, robots.txt obeyed: Wikipedia's 2026 election pages (for the campaign sites they link), the candidates' own sites, and each county's, township's, court's and school district's own pages.

Not reachable, so left blank: Ballotpedia (an empty page to scripts), the Michigan courts' judge pages (robots.txt disallows), the Governor's appointment releases and WLNS (403), the 3rd Circuit Court's judge list (drawn by script), the City of Wayne's site (no address lookup), and the Plainwell, Lakewood, East Lansing, South Lake, Whitehall, Clarenceville and Saginaw Township board pages (no text, or no match for the candidate, who may simply not be a sitting member).

No party's own endorsement page was found for anyone in this part: the Michigan Republican Party's and the Michigan Democratic Party's home pages gave scripts no text. Forlini and Schostak were chosen at the Republican convention according to news reports, which is not recorded here as endorsed_by.

Peter Ochs, Mike Steger and Bruce P. Langran (House 10, 6, 8), and Pauline Wendzel's campaign site: nothing confirmed without search. A site at peterochs.com belongs to a different person and was not used.
Michael Morris: the Gibraltar board lists "Mr. Mike Morris, Trustee"; taken as the same person (the seven-member board he is running for). A verifier may prefer to drop it.
